items: Web Mode has two kinds now: Public puts an encrypted copy on GitHub Pages (aicargoapp.github.io) that opens from any network with its link; Private works on the same Wi-Fi as the phone.
Turn on Public Web in Settings › Developer Options and connect GitHub once with a token.
Web Mode's public link is removed for now (it didn't connect). Web Mode works on the same Wi-Fi as the phone.

Web Mode now works from anywhere: turn on Public Link in Settings for an https link that opens it from any network (it always asks for the PIN), or use Tailscale for a private address on your own devices.
Web Mode keeps running in the background with a notification, and comes back after the phone restarts.

Web Mode looks and works better in a browser: a Home dashboard, a new Bookings page with each booking's live status, photo previews in a grid, a viewer for pictures and PDFs, and Ctrl+K to search everything.
Web Mode pages show when something changes on the phone, and too many wrong PINs make the browser wait.
No more keyboard flashing up while the app tracks an AWB by itself (Track Shipment, Full tracking, Track History)
Track Shipment: the airline as the portal has it (IX or AI) and the flight's own actual departure and arrival times
Shipments that change planes show the stop: DEL → BOM → COK
Track Shipment: shows the flight the cargo actually flew on, not one it was only booked on
The route is the real one (DEL to SXR), no longer two goods codes read off the page (AGC to NUT)
Track Shipment: a flight the cargo was offloaded from is no longer shown, and the flight it flew on has its departure and arrival times
The weight is the weighed one (103.5 kg, not the booking's 100 kg), and the route is shown even when the booking didn't say it
Software Update: a download made just as a new version goes up is fetched again by itself instead of failing
Settings > General > App Updates: an Update Log of every check, download and install, and what the last check found
A new version can't be missed: if its box can't come up, a notification opens Software Update
Track Shipment: the flight's arrival time is shown (scheduled or expected), with its actual departure time
The weight is read whole (1,808 kg, not 808), and Full tracking no longer splits dates
Software Update: an update published while one was downloading no longer fails as "The download didn't match"
A new version is offered even while the Track Shipment sheet or Settings is open
Track Shipment: the top card now shows the flight - AI 2458, in the air or scheduled, DEL to COK with the times and a plane on its way
The shipment's weight is always shown, taken exactly from the timeline
Auto Update (Settings > General > App Updates): new versions download and install by themselves, with the app open or closed
New versions are offered within 2 minutes while the app is open
With the app closed, a notification tells you when a new version is ready - tap it to update
Track Shipment: the keyboard no longer pops up while the sheet checks again, and the sheet stays where you scrolled it
Full tracking shows only the shipment: never the search screen, and the page no longer switches views on its own
The route no longer changes to the same airport twice (DEL → DEL), and a trolley or container (BT1331) is no longer shown as a flight
Track Shipment: Full tracking shows only your shipment - no more search form and loading squares
Track Shipment: a Summary / Full tracking switch at the top replaces the Summary button
About shows when your build was made, and What's new now lists the latest updates with their dates
Software Update shows what's new in your build even when there's nothing newer
Track Shipment: refreshes by itself every 10 seconds while it's open - the line at the top shows when it last updated
Track Shipment: fixed "Couldn't update" - it now reads the shipment's status, timeline, pieces and flight
Track Shipment: if it ever can't read one, long-press the line at the top for what it saw (with Copy)
Track Shipment: opens straight away with where your shipment is, then updates itself - no more portal form and spinner
Track Shipment: pull it up for the full timeline with places and times, pieces, goods and flights; Details, Share and Reminder always at the bottom
Track Shipment page: tracking several AWBs gives each one a tab with its status
New updates now pop up within minutes - each time you come back to the app, and every 15 minutes while it's open (it used to wait up to an hour)
All Bookings: View Details is back in each booking's ⋮ menu (and swiping a booking right opens it)
The ⋮ menu no longer has AWB QR Code
Profile sheet: swipe right to sign out
Tapping your profile picture at the top opens your profile again
The little down arrow next to it stays hidden and does nothing
Header: tapping your profile circle no longer opens anything (sign out is in Settings)
Header: the down arrow beside your profile circle is gone
Header: the little down arrow beside your profile circle is gone
Saved Files: each AWB with its route (DEL to BOM, and the cities), booking date, pieces, weight and status - and a search box
All Bookings filter: Booking Status - Confirmed and Queued can be picked again
All Bookings filter: room to type - the airport list opens below its box
